Working notes — routing decisions (REQ-2400 to REQ-2409)

Status: no successful assignment yet. All attempted options returned +0.00 "Rejected."

Observed requests:
- Types: refund, shipment, claim.
- Regions: north, south, east.
- Sizes: small, large.
- Sources/departments: Field Sales, Client Services, Partner Accounts, Regional Ops, Finance Desk.

Rejections:
- Option C (regional office) was attempted on almost every ticket (REQ-2401–REQ-2409, plus REQ-2400? no, REQ-2400 was B) and was rejected every time. Conclusion: avoid C for routing these requests.
- Option B (priority desk) was attempted once on REQ-2400: large refund, north region. Rejected. Evidence limited, but B is invalid for at least that case.
- Option A (standard queue) has not been attempted. It remains the best untested fallback.

Future guidance:
- Do not choose C.
- Avoid B unless new evidence supports it; B may be inappropriate for large refunds/north region.
- Try A next when assigning these routing tickets.
- Continue tracking request type, region, size, and source to find any valid special-case mapping.
- Ticket phrasing urgency ("no rush", "before end of day", "second attempt") has not predicted validity so far.

Working notes — routing decisions (REQ-2400–REQ-2419)

Status: valid mapping found. A (standard queue) accepts **small refunds from south region**. Accepted on REQ-2411–REQ-2414 across Field Sales, Regional Ops, and Client Services. Source and phrasing did not matter for these.

Confirmed:
- C (regional office) rejected on every attempted ticket (REQ-2401–REQ-2409). Do not choose C.
- B (priority desk) rejected once: large refund/north (REQ-2400). Limited evidence; may still fit other cases.
- A is not a general fallback. A rejected for:
  - small invoice/east (REQ-2410)
  - small claim/north (REQ-2415–2416)
  - small shipment/south (REQ-2417)
  - large invoice/east (REQ-2418)
  - small claim/south (REQ-2419)

Therefore A works only for: **type=refund, size=small, region=south** so far.

Sources/departments and urgency phrases (“no rush”, “second attempt”, “before end of day”, “regional office”, “scanned not typed”) have not predicted validity. Track type, region, size.

Future guidance:
- For small refund/south: choose A.
- For other requests: avoid C. If A is rejected, try B next, but note B may be invalid for large refunds/north.
- Prioritize testing B on A-rejected combinations, especially claims north/south, shipments south, invoices east.
- Update mapping by type/region/size after each outcome.

Working notes — routing decisions (REQ-2400–REQ-2429)

Valid mappings:
- A (standard queue): only confirmed for type=refund, size=small, region=south (REQ-2411–2414).
- B (priority desk): confirmed for shipments north/east, small or large (REQ-2422, 2426–2428); and large claim/north (REQ-2421).
- C (regional office): rejected on all attempts (REQ-2401–2409). Do not choose.
- D: invalid (REQ-2420).

B rejections:
- refunds: large/north (REQ-2400), large/south (REQ-2423–2424), small/north (REQ-2429).
- small claim/south (REQ-2425).
So B is not a general fallback; avoid B for refunds and small claim/south.

A rejections:
- small invoice/east (2410)
- small claim/north (2415–2416)
- small shipment/south (2417)
- large invoice/east (2418)
- small claim/south (2419)
A remains narrow.

Sources/departments and urgency phrases (“no rush”, “second attempt”, “before end of day”, “regional office”, “scanned not typed”) have not predicted validity. Track type, region, size.

Future guidance:
- small refund/south -> A.
- shipment north/east, any size -> B.
- large claim/north -> B.
- avoid C; D invalid.
- For untested combinations, try B next, but expect B to fail for refunds and small claim/south.
- Prioritize testing A on large refund/south (B rejected) and other A-rejected claims/shipments/invoices; update mapping after each outcome.

Working notes — routing (REQ-2400–2439)

Valid:
- A: small refund/south only (2411–14).
- B: large shipment/north (2430); large claim/north (2421); small claim/north (2435); small claim/east (2431); large invoice/east (2438). Earlier B shipment north/east confirmed (2422, 2426–28), but small shipment/north now rejected (2437).
- C: no accepted result yet (2401–09); use only if A and B both fail/tested.

B rejections:
- refunds: large/north (2400), large/south (2423–24), small/north (2429).
- claim/south: small (2425), large (2434, 2439).
- small shipment/north (2437).

A rejections:
- small invoice/east (2410)
- small claim/north (2415–16)
- small shipment/south (2417)
- large invoice/east (2418)
- small claim/south (2419)
- small refund/north (2432, 2436)
- small refund/east (2433)
A remains narrow.

D invalid.

Sources/urgency phrases still not predictive. Track type, region, size.

Future:
- small refund/south -> A.
- small claim/north/east -> B.
- large claim/north -> B.
- large shipment/north -> B.
- large invoice/east -> B.
- claim/south: B rejected; try A for large claim/south. Small claim/south already A-rejected -> C candidate.
- small shipment/north: B rejected; try A.
- small refund/north: A/B rejected -> C candidate.
- small refund/east: A rejected; try B cautiously, then C.
- Untested non-refund/non-claim-south/non-small-shipment-north: try B, then A, then C as last resort. Update after each outcome.

Working notes — routing (REQ-2400–2449)

Valid:
- A: small refund/south only (2411–14).
- B: small/large claim north (2421,2435,2448); small claim/east (2431); large claim/east (2440,2446); earlier shipment north/east (2422,2426–28). Large shipment/north (2430) and large invoice/east (2438) were accepted but now contradicted (2445,2447).
- C: small claim/south (2441); large refund/east (2443). Use when A/B fail.

B rejections:
- refunds: large/north, large/south, small/north.
- claim/south: small (2425), large (2434,2439).
- shipment: small/north (2437), large/north (2445; conflicts 2430).
- invoice: small/north (2444), small/south (2449), large/east (2447; conflicts 2438).

A rejections:
- small invoice/east; small claim/north; small shipment/south; large invoice/east; small claim/south; small refund/north/east; large claim/south (2442). A remains narrow.

D invalid.

Sources/urgency phrases still not predictive. Track type, region, size.

Future:
- small refund/south -> A.
- small/large claim north/east -> B.
- small claim/south -> C.
- large claim/south: A/B rejected -> C.
- large refund/east -> C.
- small shipment/north: B rejected -> try A.
- small refund/north: A/B rejected -> C.
- small refund/east: A rejected -> try B, then C.
- small invoice north/south: B rejected -> try A, then C.
- small invoice/east: A rejected -> try B, then C.
- large shipment/north: B unstable/rejected -> try A, then C.
- large invoice/east: A/B rejected -> C.
- Untested other types: try B, then A, then C. Update after each outcome.

Working notes — routing (REQ-2400–2459)

Valid:
- A: small invoice/north (2453). Small refund/south no longer A: 2451–52 rejected.
- B: small/large claim north; small claim/east; large claim/east; earlier shipment north/east. B unstable for large shipment/north (2430 vs 2445) and large invoice/east (2438 vs 2447).
- C: small claim/south; large refund/east; large refund/south (2450,2458). Use when A/B fail unless C rejected.

Rejections:
- A: small refund/south (2451–52); small invoice/east; small claim/north; small shipment/south; large invoice/east; small claim/south; small refund/north/east; large claim/south. A remains narrow.
- B: refunds large/north, large/south, small/north; claim/south small/large; shipment small/north, large/north, small/east (2457), small/south (2459); invoice small/north, small/south, large/east, small/east (2454); small refund/east (2455).
- C: large invoice/east (2456).
- D invalid.

Sources/urgency phrases still not predictive. Track type, region, size.

Future:
- small invoice/north -> A.
- small/large claim north/east -> B.
- small claim/south -> C.
- large claim/south -> C.
- large refund/south or east -> C.
- small refund/south -> try B, then C (A rejected).
- small refund/north -> C (A/B rejected).
- small refund/east -> try C (A/B rejected).
- small invoice/east -> try C (A/B rejected).
- small invoice/south -> try A, then C (B rejected).
- small shipment/north -> try A, then C (B rejected).
- small shipment/east -> try A, then C (B rejected).
- small shipment/south -> try C (A/B rejected).
- large shipment/north -> try A, then C (B unstable/rejected).
- large invoice/east -> A/B/C rejected, D invalid: unresolved.
- Untested other types: try B, then A, then C. Update after each outcome.
